summary: Iteration 41 — Orrbbit Master Dashboard branding & theme pass. Frontend-only, tested at 1440x800 (+ 900x800 responsive spot-check) against the preview URL, logging in as qa-admin@intro.control. ALL 8 REQUESTED FLOWS PASS with only two low-severity UX/console findings (both non-blocking, non-regressive). FLOW 1 /control/login: official Orrbbit logo image renders (assets/images/logo.png, 512x512), heading 'Orrbbit Master Dashboard', subtitle 'Authorised access only', teal Sign In button, white card on light-teal background with subtle radar rings; login with qa-admin@intro.control / QawqvEcQ-eOdWT!7 succeeds and lands on /control. FLOW 2 /control: greeting 'Good morning, Qa-admin' + 'Here's what's happening across Orrbbit.', KPI cards render (Total Users 80, Online 79, MAU 80, Professionals 13, Verified 13, Expired Credentials 2, Active Help Requests 14), 'Not configured' cards for Subscriptions & Revenue in DEMO (correct — no fake revenue), System Status shows pills (Server/Database/Api/Storage Operational teal, Email Not Configured orange, Push Notifications Mocked orange, Payments Not Configured), charts render with teal series (User Growth, Pings) + orange series (Connections), sidebar top shows Orrbbit logo + 'Orrbbit / Control Centre', active Dashboard item has soft-teal rounded pill (bg #E6F6F5 style), top bar DEMO badge visible with dot + swap icon (light-teal explicit text 'DEMO'). FLOW 3 mode switch: tapping DEMO badge opens a modal 'Switch to LIVE mode?' with body 'LIVE mode connects directly to production data. Every action affects real users and is fully audited.' + 'DEMO mode uses isolated seeded data and never touches production.' + Stay in DEMO / Enter LIVE mode (red) buttons; Enter LIVE mode → badge becomes 'LIVE · PRODUCTION' with green outline + green dot, header changes to 'LIVE Data', KPI values refresh (Total Users 163, MAU 142, Reports Pending 5, Reports (30d) chart shows red spike). Clicking avatar → profile menu shows qa-admin@intro.control, 'Super Admin' teal role pill, 'Environment: LIVE · Production' (or 'DEMO · Isolated data'), 'Change password' (teal), 'Sign out' (red). Switch back to DEMO confirmed working. FLOW 4 /control/users: table renders, ALL demo users show a light-teal 'DEMO' pill next to name (26 DEMO pills counted in first page), verified users additionally show teal ✓ tick, status = 'Active' teal pill, filter chips (All/Active/Suspended/Banned) render with All active in teal-soft. FLOW 5 /control/subscriptions (DEMO): teal info card 'DEMO DATA — clearly-labelled seeded billing records…' (NOT blue), Plans column shows exactly 'Orrbbit Free' (Radar up to 250 m, Core radar, Age preference filter), 'Orrbbit Plus' (Radar up to 500 m, Priority pings), 'Orrbbit Pro' (Radar up to 1 km, Professional tools, Verified badge priority) — retired keys 'intro_plus', 'intro_professional' NOT present; demo subscriptions table shows plan values 'orrbbit plus' / 'orrbbit pro' (demo_sub_000..009 reseeded). FLOW 6 spot-check pages: /control/verifications (Approved 13, Rejected 2, Expired 2, Expiring Soon 1, empty pending queue), /control/reports (Pending/Actioned/Dismissed tabs, 'No reports here.'), /control/system-health (Api/Database/Storage Operational with latency + disk), /control/audit-logs (table renders with columns WHEN/ADMIN/ACTION/TARGET/MODE/CHANGES/IP), /control/analytics (Sign-ups & Pings in teal shade, Connections in orange, Help Requests in navy/gray, Professional Growth in green — NO generic blue anywhere; Conversion Funnel bars teal, Retention list renders). All 5 pages loaded without React error boundary or red screen. FLOW 7 responsive 900x800: sidebar collapses off-screen, hamburger menu icon (Ionicons menu) shown at top-left of header, top bar shows DEMO badge + notification bell + Q avatar, tables/KPIs still fully usable in single column stack. FLOW 8 no regressions: global search input placeholder 'Search users, professionals, requests…' works (typed 'kauri' → dropdown row 'Kauri · kauri@intro.demo' rendered under the search box within ~2s), 6+ sidebar items navigated (Dashboard, Users, Subscriptions, Verifications, Reports, System Health, Audit Logs, Analytics) without any navigator/route error, and Sign out from profile menu returns to /control/login with the email/password form re-rendered. Console noise observed but non-blocking: (a) RN-Web deprecation warnings 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (surfaced by react-native-web ≥0.19 – pre-existing, not caused by this iteration); (b) one navigator warning on the login redirect: 'The action REPLACE with payload {"name":"index"} was not handled by any navigator.' — cosmetic development-only log, redirect still lands on /control correctly.

issues: Profile avatar Pressable (line 191) has no testID and no accessibilityLabel — automated tests must rely on coordinate clicks or DOM heuristics. Sibling mode-badge Pressable (line 176) already has accessibilityLabel; recommend adding testID='header-avatar' + accessibilityLabel='Account menu' for parity. Not user-facing; QA-only.

react_native_issues.issue: Console emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' on every /control page load. Non-blocking today but will break on future RN-Web major bump. Reference: repeated across Shell.tsx / ui.tsx style objects using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius and <View pointerEvents=…> props.

action_items: (Low) Add testID='header-avatar' + accessibilityLabel='Account menu' to the avatar Pressable in /app/frontend/src/control/Shell.tsx:191 so the profile dropdown (email, Super Admin badge, Environment line, Change password, Sign out) is discoverable via a stable selector rather than coordinate clicks.

(Low, tech-debt) Migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow and <View pointerEvents> to style.pointerEvents inside Shell.tsx / ui.tsx to silence the RN-Web deprecation warnings that spam the console on every Control Centre page load.
critical_code_review_comments: Shell.tsx mode badge correctly renders 'LIVE · PRODUCTION' with green dot/text vs 'DEMO' with teal dot/text (lines 182-186); the accessibilityLabel is descriptive; confirm-modal copy matches spec exactly.

Subscriptions page cleanly renders 'Not configured' cards for MRR/Revenue in LIVE (verified: still no fake revenue after switch), and teal-soft DEMO DATA disclaimer replaces the previous blue notice; plan keys are hard-migrated to orrbbit_free/plus/pro (no legacy intro_* strings present in DEMO seed or UI).
control/index.tsx greeting 'Good morning, {firstName}' derives correctly from admin.email local part with title case; subline copy matches spec.
sidebar active nav pill uses soft-teal rounded background (bg #E6F6F5) + teal text, matches spec; empty states across verifications/reports show teal icon circles with muted secondary text.
Analytics chart palette uses distinct teal, orange, navy, green shades per series — no generic app-blue leaked through (confirmed visually).

success_rate.backend: not tested (frontend-only iteration per review request)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 8 requested flows verified end-to-end; only 2 low-severity findings, both cosmetic/tech-debt.

seed_data_creation: None. Left qa-admin session signed out after final sign-out test. Mode restored to DEMO before sign-out. No production data was modified while in LIVE mode (look-only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login POST /api/control/auth/login → response key 'token' (NOT access_token). Header avatar Pressable in Shell.tsx has no testID/accessibilityLabel — click via coordinates (approx x=851, y=29 at 1440x800) or add a testID before writing further Playwright. Mode toggle: tap the DEMO/LIVE·PRODUCTION badge in the header → confirm modal → 'Enter LIVE mode' (red) or 'Stay in DEMO'. LIVE mode is production data, look-only, ban/delete/suspend actions return HTTP 428. Global search input placeholder 'Search users, professionals, requests…'. Sidebar hamburger appears at viewport width ≤ ~1000px.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Two low-severity items: (1) missing testID/accessibilityLabel on the header avatar Pressable at Shell.tsx:191 (QA discoverability only, no user impact); (2) RN-Web shadow* / pointerEvents deprecation warnings originating from Shell.tsx/ui.tsx style objects and legacy <View pointerEvents> props — pre-existing, harmless today, worth a batch clean-up before the next RN-Web major upgrade.
